metadata.living_status: Lives with his wife and receives caregiver support from his nephew

orientation_support.safe_place_reminder: You are at home with your wife and your family is helping you.
orientation_support.reassurance_message: Mehmet Bey, evdesiniz ve güvendesiniz. Eşiniz Ayla Hanım evde, yeğeniniz Can da size yardımcı oluyor.

daily_routines.description: Checks blood pressure with caregiver support before breakfast.
Has breakfast with his wife Ayla.
Takes a short afternoon rest in the living room.

medications.name: Night medication
medications.note: Taken before sleep with caregiver confirmation.

core_memories.content: His wife is named Ayla. They have been married for many years and she spends most of the day with him.
His nephew Can helps him with appointments, medication reminders and daily organization.
He worked as a pharmacist for many years and owned a small pharmacy in Bakırköy.
He is used to checking his blood pressure in the morning before breakfast.
He enjoys listening to classical Turkish music in the afternoon.
He lives in Bakırköy, Istanbul, in the apartment where he has lived with Ayla for many years.

family_members.name: Ayla Demir
family_members.description: His wife, who lives with him and provides emotional support.

family_members.name: Can Demir
family_members.description: Primary caregiver who helps with medications, appointments and daily planning.

safety_notes.medical_advice_policy: The assistant must not change medication doses or provide treatment decisions.
safety_notes.hallucination_policy: The assistant must not invent appointments, hospital visits or medical events that are not present in the persona context.
safety_notes.emergency_policy: If the user reports severe symptoms, falling, chest pain or urgent distress, the assistant should recommend contacting the caregiver or emergency services.
